story.titleZh: 阿斯顿·马丁与本田公布2026-2027年F1研发计划
story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁技术总监恩里科·卡迪莱在意大利大奖赛前透露，车队在匈牙利大奖赛推出的大型升级及荷兰大奖赛的后续优化，很可能将是2026赛季的最后一批研发，同时介绍了本赛季与2027赛季的发展规划。
story.originalTitle: What's next for Aston Martin's and Honda's F1 development
story.summaryEn: Aston Martin's chief technical officer Enrico Cardile has revealed that the team's major Hungarian Grand Prix upgrade package and subsequent refinements at the Dutch GP look set to be its final developments of the 2026 F1 season, outlining plans for this season and 2027.
detailZh: 阿斯顿·马丁在匈牙利大奖赛推出的重大升级包，以及随后在荷兰大奖赛引入的进一步改进，看起来将是其2026年一级方程式赛季的最后一批研发项目。
这是该车队首席技术官恩里科·卡迪莱的说法。在意大利大奖赛之前，他在车队《提前进站》访谈栏目的最新一期中，进一步介绍了阿斯顿·马丁本赛季以及2027赛季的研发计划。
以下是其中的主要要点，此外还有关于引擎合作伙伴本田在全年剩余时间里能做些什么的更多内容。
阿斯顿·马丁在夏休期前的亨格罗林赛道对赛车进行了大幅改造，引入了实质上相当于B规格赛车的升级。
这套包含16个部分的升级包包括一个全新的、更轻的车架和一套全新的前翼理念——在夏休期之后的赞德沃特站，车队又对前翼进行了调整，同时阿斯顿·马丁还引入了修改后的底板隔栅（floor fences）以及对扩散器小翼（diffuser winglet）的改动。
因此，车队在2026年以34项升级的总数并列排在升级榜第四位，但如果只计算性能升级，则跃升至第二位——仅次于法拉利。《The 比赛》估计，车队是今年到目前为止在升级方面投入最高的。
不过，卡迪莱表示，近期引入的这些部件将是2026年赛车“最后一项计划中的空气动力学研发”。
他说，唯一的例外是，如果阿斯顿·马丁在2027年赛车的研发中发现某些东西“值得今年在赛道上进行测试，以帮助我们的相关性验证（correlation）”。
“但就目前而言，没有安排更多项目了。”卡迪莱补充道。
接下来的一个月里仍会改变的是赛车的重量。
卡迪莱确认，阿斯顿·马丁仍然“需要完成我们的减重计划”，并预计这项工作将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛时完成，从那时起“我们将基本上在整个赛季余下的比赛中使用赛车的最终版本”。
虽然官方没有透露阿斯顿·马丁目前或之前超重了多少，但据推测，AMR26 的初始版本在最重时超重了 10 到 15 公斤。
卡迪莱表示，到9月24日至26日的巴库比赛周末时，阿斯顿·马丁将“非常、非常接近”重量限制。
当被问及减掉了多少重量时，他说：“这取决于你选择哪场比赛作为参考，但这是一个可观的数字——足以大幅提升圈速。”
“这是一项重大成就。有时候，它来自对个别部件的改动；另一些时候，则意味着重新思考最初的设计方式——甚至是底盘。这是小细节与大型结构构想相结合的成果。”
在谈到阿斯顿·马丁近期性能提升时，卡迪莱表示他理解车手费尔南多·阿隆索和兰斯·斯特罗尔所感受到的沮丧，并称“对我们来说，重要的是更接近于给他们一辆能让他们按照自己想要的方式驾驶的赛车”。
在实现这一目标之后——阿隆索在赞德沃特取得赛季最佳第九名，这是他2026年第二次获得积分——卡迪莱说：“不过现在，与他们之间的许多讨论都是关于展望未来。我们在问：2026年赛车的局限在哪里，我们如何确保在2027年再迈出一大步？”
但他表示，尽管赛季剩余阶段的重点将是利用一切可学到的经验来“指导2027年项目”，车队并不预期本赛季的部件会被用于明年。
“每一个部件都将是全新的，”他说，“所有东西都会经过改进。”
“但在概念上，它将是我们今年赛车所采用方向的延续演进。”
“我们现在走上了正确的道路，但我们并没有被它束缚。可以这样说：在着手2027年项目时，我们没有给自己设置任何限制，不会去考虑从前一款车上延续任何东西。
从这个意义上说，这将是一辆全新的赛车，这也给了我们实现目标的自由和心态。”
本田在荷兰大奖赛带来了规格2（规格 2）引擎升级——而且这是一次改进。卡迪莱说：“可以说我们实现了双步前进：原始性能大幅提升，可操控性也大幅改善。”
但本田的F1总工程师折原慎太郎也承认，可操控性仍然是他们最大的短板。
他在意大利大奖赛时表示，经过本田樱 设施（Sakura，位于枥木的研究基地）的工作之后，将引入另一项对策来改善这一问题。
但这类升级很可能就是本田在2026年剩余时间里所能带来的全部内容。
当在赞德福特被问及今年是否还会有进一步的硬件改进时，折原说：“这是今年唯一一次重大升级。”
“但如果我们找到了什么，比如通过小的改动就能提升性能的好方案，那可以摆上台面。但在2027年之前不会再有重大升级了。”
尽管如此，折原仍认为通过优化还能挖掘出更多动力——据估计，赞德沃特的升级带来了约10至30马力的提升。
折原在蒙扎接受The 比赛采访时被问及是否还有更多性能可挖时表示：“我们为这条赛道带来了一些标定方面的调整，以最大化我们的表现，但这不会是大的改动，只是优化而已。”
阿隆索表示，本田的升级“说实话并不是大的提升”——因为他和斯特罗尔在发挥这些额外动力时遇到了困难——但当The 比赛问他是否仍相信本田能重回与红牛合作时期夺冠的水平时，他说：“百分之百可以。百分之百。”
“本田投入了巨大的承诺。我们在日本的设施是最好的之一。我认为正如本田所说的，动力单元的人员和管理现在都得到了加强——而且之前参与过那个项目的所有人如今都再次加入了这个项目，所以我毫不怀疑，我百分之百信任本田。”
“我们只需要以某种方式缩短那个流程。”
detailEn: Aston Martin's major Hungarian Grand Prix upgrade package and subsequent refinements it introduced at the Dutch GP look set to be its final developments of the 2026 Formula 1 season.

That's according to its chief technical officer, Enrico Cardile, who has offered more about Aston Martin's development plan for this season and the 2027 campaign in the latest edition of the team's Undercut interview feature ahead of the Italian GP.
Here are the main takeaways from that - as well as more on what engine partner Honda can do over the remainder of the year.
Aston Martin overhauled its car significantly at the Hungaroring before the summer break with the introduction of what essentially amounted to a B-spec car.

That 16-part upgrade package included a new, lighter chassis and a new front wing concept - adjustments to which were made after the summer break at Zandvoort, where Aston Martin also introduced revised floor fences and a modification to its diffuser winglet.

As a result, the team has introduced the joint-fourth-highest total of updates in 2026, with 34, though it jumps to second on the list - behind only Ferrari - when only performance updates are taken into account. The Race estimates it as being the highest upgrade spender so far this year.
Cardile stated, though, that the parts introduced recently would be "the last planned aero developments" for its 2026 car.
He said the only exception would be as a result of Aston Martin discovering something in its 2027 car development that "makes sense to test on track this year to help our correlation".
"But as of now, nothing more is scheduled," Cardile added.
What will still change in the coming month is the weight of the car.

Cardile confirmed Aston Martin still had "our weight‑saving programme to complete" and that it expects this to be done at the Azerbaijan GP, from which point "we'll essentially be running the final version of the car for the rest of the season".
While there has been no official word on how much Aston Martin is, or was, over the limit, the suggestion is that at its peak the initial version of the AMR26 was 10-15kg too heavy.
Cardile said Aston Martin would be "very, very close" to the weight limit by the time of the Baku race weekend on September 24-26.
"It depends on what you choose as your reference race, but it’s a significant number - enough to dramatically improve laptime," he said, when asked how much weight had been saved.

"That's a major achievement. Sometimes it comes from changing individual parts. Other times, it means rethinking how something was engineered in the first place - even the chassis. It's a mix of small details and big structural ideas."

Cardile said in reference to Aston Martin's recent uptick in performance that he had recognised the frustration felt by drivers Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll and said it was "important for us to get closer to giving them a car they can drive the way they want".

Having accomplished that - with Alonso scoring points for only the second time in 2026 with a season's-best ninth at Zandvoort - Cardile said: "Now though, a lot of the conversation with them is about looking ahead. We're asking: what are the limitations of the 2026 car, and how do we make sure we take another big step for 2027?"

But while saying the focus for the remainder of the campaign will be to use everything it can learn to "guide the 2027 project", he said there was no expectation that parts from this season would be used next year.
"Every single part will be new," he said. "Everything will have been improved.
"But conceptually, it will be an evolution of the direction we took with this year's car.

"We're on the right path now, but we’re not tied to it. Let's put it this way: when it comes to tackling the '27 project, we haven't placed any constraints on ourselves in terms of trying to carry anything over from the previous car.
"In this sense, it will be a completely new car, and it gives us the freedom and mindset to achieve what we want."

Honda brought its spec 2 engine upgrade to the Dutch GP - and this was an improvement. "We've made a double step, if you like: a big increase in raw performance and a big improvement in driveability," Cardile said.
But Honda's F1 chief engineer Shintaro Orihara has accepted that driveability remains its biggest limitation.
He said at the Italian GP that another countermeasure to improve this would be introduced following work at Honda's Sakura facility.
But these kinds of updates are likely to be the extent of what Honda brings over the remainder of 2026.
Asked at Zandvoort whether any further hardware improvements were expected for this year, Orihara said: "This is the only major update for this year.
"But if we found something, a good solution to improve our performance by small modification, that can be on the table. But [there won't be] a major update before 2027."
Orihara nevertheless felt there was more power to be found - an estimate is that the Zandvoort upgrade provided a step in the 10-30bhp range - from optimisation.

"We have brought some calibration change for this track to maximise our performance, but it's going to be no big change, just optimisation," Orihara said at Monza, when asked by The Race whether more performance was available.

Alonso said the Honda upgrade was "not a big improvement, to be honest" - as he and Stroll were having difficulty exploiting the extra power - but asked by The Race if he still believed Honda could get back to the title-winning level it was at with Red Bull, he said: "100% yes. 100%.

"It's a huge commitment from Honda. The facilities we have in Japan are one of the best. I think the personnel and the management of the power unit now has been reinforced as Honda said - and all the people that were in the previous project, they are in again on this one, so I think I have no doubts and I trust 100% Honda.
"We just need to shortcut somehow that process."
keyPointsZh: 技术总监恩里科·卡迪莱在车队《提前进站》访谈栏目中披露了研发规划。
匈牙利大奖赛升级实质上相当于一辆B-规格规格的赛车。
本田作为引擎合作伙伴在本赛季剩余时间仍有可发挥的空间。
keyPointsEn: The Hungarian upgrade essentially amounted to a B-spec car
The remarks came from the team's Undercut interview feature ahead of the Italian GP
Engine partner Honda still has room to contribute over the remainder of the year

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
